executionScope.purpose: Local authenticated desktop diagnosis of the repeated session-activity RPC inside the shared auth chain.
executionScope.fixture: local-normal synthetic owner with real password session and normal RLS/API path
executionScope.journeyBoundary: J1 selected from each run's valid normal observations; three diagnostic repetitions per variant

hypothesis.statement: The session-activity assertion executed inside every normal authenticated API request is a shared auth-chain cost that contributes to the two-second interaction freeze.
hypothesis.baselineA: Calls without recordSessionActivity execute assertShellSessionActivity through the p85_stage_5_record_session_activity_v3 RPC.
hypothesis.variableB: Calls without recordSessionActivity skip that assertion and use the already verified session id; the explicit /api/session/activity endpoint remains the touch owner.

A1.observationSummary: 12/12 observation-valid; selected J1 diagnostic 3/3 valid and successful
A1.sampler: PASS; 615 samples; zero errors; zero lock-wait samples

B.observationSummary: 11/12 observation-valid; selected J1 diagnostic 3/3 valid and successful
B.sampler: PASS; 651 samples; zero errors; zero lock-wait samples

A2.observationSummary: 12/12 observation-valid; selected J1 diagnostic 3/3 valid and successful
A2.sampler: PARTIAL; 675 samples; one sample error; zero lock-wait samples

measuredEffect.sessionActivityRpcBoundary: B reduced the contained session-activity timing to approximately zero in all three selected J1 repetitions.
measuredEffect.requestFanout: A1/B/A2 each recorded 53 total requests, 24 API requests, and 26 RSC requests in all three selected J1 diagnostic repetitions.
measuredEffect.reactCommit: Commit counts and actual durations remained variable; B did not produce a stable lower interaction tail or commit cost.
measuredEffect.direction: The targeted RPC cost was removed, but the user-visible second-action speed did not improve in a repeatable A-B-A direction.

validity.functionalOutcome: All selected J1 diagnostic observations completed the required reads and second action successfully.
validity.scope: This is diagnostic evidence and is not an official nine-scenario acceptance run.

sampler.interpretation: Sampler output is bounded observation only; the A2 sample error prevents any global lock-absence claim.

behaviorAndSafety.BSelectedJourney: Real authenticated session, normal RLS/API path, required reads 2xx/body-finished, second action accepted, and functional success 3/3.
behaviorAndSafety.explicitActivityOwner: The /api/session/activity endpoint remained the explicit touch path during B.
behaviorAndSafety.safetyBoundary: No tenant, role, mutation, migration, production, provider, billing, worker, or real health-data path was used or changed.
behaviorAndSafety.runtimeStateAfterA2: Baseline auth assertion path restored; B change is absent from checkout.

explicitNonClaims: Removing the assertion in B is not an approved production fix.
The measured session-activity span is not proof that this RPC caused the global freeze.
The diagnostic run does not reopen Plan 1 closure or authorize Plan 2.
The sampler does not prove absence of database lock contention outside the observed windows.

closure.runtimeState: A2 baseline restored; only the measurement runner deadline extension and this evidence record remain from this continuation.
closure.nextAction: Keep the auth/session chain in the shared freeze hypothesis, but move diagnosis to a different separately authorized boundary; do not accept or deploy the B behavior.
